summary.headline: Astrolabe Chapters and Astrological Prognostics
summary.text: Catalog of Vatican Codex 11 entries on lunar eclipses, Dorotheus’s astrological effects, and John Philoponus’s 14 chapters on using the astrolabe, including anti-nativity, timekeeping, geographic latitude, star identification, pole elevation, and engraving accuracy. The final entry cites Galen’s decumbiture prognostics from mathematical science, edited in Kühn’s edition.
